scope: completed full-split code dense retrieval comparisons; no reranker or answer generator
source_report_hash_scope: SHA256 of each exported report.json; local run bytes checked equal

paired_grouping.description: Queries sharing a positively labelled source function are connected; corpus IDs identify functions, not entire repositories.
paired_grouping.resampling_assumption: Identified source components are treated as exchangeable resampling units; unrecorded cross-component dependencies may remain.

paired_bootstrap.estimator: query-weighted mean difference; groups resampled together

dominant_group_guard.interpretation: conservative reporting safeguard, not a formal statistical threshold

paired_bootstrap.multiple_comparison_adjustment: none; intervals are marginal exploratory comparisons

selection_audit.selection_rule: Official preprocess.py: emit codebase.txt URL only if present in raw validation/test

limitations: G/E per-input encoding diagnostics unavailable, not measured zero truncation.
Source-function grouping does not cluster repositories; residual cross-function dependence may remain.
Marginal exploratory intervals without multiple-comparison correction.
Full frozen gallery means the official cleaned validation/test intersection, not all original CodeSearchNet functions.
Retrieval is not generated-code correctness or answer accuracy.
